items.summary: Researchers added hidden text to contact AI agents probing Alibaba’s map service, getting replies about their tasks as investigators traced activity to Tencent Cloud infrastructure.

items.title: Google Says It Just Cracked One of Quantum Computing's Biggest Bottlenecks
items.summary: Google's Willow chip cut errors 40x on the scarce “magic states” quantum computers burn through, a step toward smaller, useful machines—and toward ones that could threaten today's encryption.

items.title: Google Says AI Isn't Building Itself Yet—Even Though It Writes 75% of the Code
items.summary: Google DeepMind's first internal audit of AI-driven research finds no measurable speedup in AI progress.

items.title: Wholesale prices jumped 6.3% annually in September, biggest gain since 2022
items.summary: September producer prices were expected to increase 0.6% month over month and 5.5% annually, according to the consensus estimate by Dow Jones.

items.title: Casa de Tierra / Walter Fernando Castañeda Luquerna
items.summary: Located at an altitude of 3,012 meters above sea level, in a transitional landscape between Andean high-altitude forest and the páramo ecosystem, Casa de Tierra explores ways of inhabiting an environmentally sensitive territory through a strategy of minimal occupation and low environmental impact.

items.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse review - inspired by great ideas, but doomed by questionable execution
items.summary: In my office, I have a collage of Ordnance Survey maps plastered across my wall. They're from places I've lived - Derbyshire, East London, Bournemouth, Bristol - with cycle routes, country roads, and parks highlighted and circled.

items.title: Typological Drift: Emerging Cities in China
items.summary: Typological Drift: Emerging Cities in China documents the impact of the Chinese culture on the development of city types in China in the past four decades, leading to surprising urban realities that often escape normative urban theories.

items.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
items.summary: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.
